_comment: The allowlist of packs the parked-vehicle build may read (openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-30-cc0-vehicles, design section 4). Each pack is pinned by the SHA-256 of its download. tools/deps/fetch_character_tools.py fetches every list in tools/deps into a cache outside the repository and refuses a pack whose hash differs; tools/blender/build_vehicles_cc0.py converts the chosen models from the verified pack only. The pack never enters the repository: only the converted models and the textures they use do, with this record of where they came from.

packs.name: PSX Style Cars by GGBotNet, the August 2023 release
packs.author: GGBotNet
packs.licence_stated_in: The pack's OpenGameArt page, whose licence field reads CC0 (fetched 2026-09-30); the zip carries no licence file of its own, only a link to the author's itch.io page (GGBot - itch.io.URL).
